title: Protecting Social Workers against Threats or Harassment On The Job
what_it_is: Protecting Social Workers against Threats or Harassment On The Job

sections.label: Reporting threats against social workers
sections.summary: Social workers facing threats or harassment should report to Police, MSF and employers, and MSF will provide guidance and support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: When our professionals face threats or harassment from clients, they should promptly report the matter to the Police, MSF as well as their employers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Consistent reporting to the authorities is the most effective way to address such incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Following the report, my Ministry will provide guidance and support to the affected social worker while Police investigations are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: If a Police investigation is not initiated, MSF will provide guidance to the affected social worker on lodging a Magistrate's Complaint.

sections.label: MSF support after reports
sections.summary: MSF appoints a dedicated officer as contact with Police and may guide social workers to pursue a Magistrate's Complaint.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: As I mentioned, consistent reporting is probably the best response to any social service professional who encounters a threat, verbal or physical abuse, or harassment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And after the report has been lodged, MSF will appoint a dedicated officer to serve as a point of contact on behalf of the social service worker with the Police.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And even if the case is assessed to have not crossed the line or threshold for proactive investigation, MSF may guide and advise the social service worker to pursue civil remedies in the form of a Magistrate's Complaint, if it is necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We will consider the Member's suggestion on public education on measures that MSF can take to protect social service professionals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Like Ms Yeo, MSF does not tolerate any abuse of our social service frontliners and if there are specific cases that the Member has in mind for which MSF can assist with, we would be happy to follow up with her separately.
